svg.title: Finding one key
svg.desc: An animation in four steps. Player 4127 signs in, and the game loads the profile through the index on players(player_id), a B-tree with one root page, three internal pages, and nine leaf pages, each holding two keys. The search reads the root, where 4127 falls between the separators 3608 and 6302, so it takes the middle downlink. The internal page below sends it down the leftmost downlink, because 4127 is below 4581. The leaf holds 4127 and a pointer to its row in the players table, and Tapir's profile loads. The lookup took three page reads, one per level. A dashed fourth level then shows that one more level would multiply the keys within reach by the fanout of 3, from 18 to 54, for one more page read.
svg.text: Player 4127 signs in, and the index on players(player_id) reads one page per level.
Each page here holds two keys. A real index page holds a few hundred.
Player 4127 signs in. The root's separators send 4127 to one child: it falls between 3608 and 6302, so the search takes the middle downlink.
An internal page narrows it down again: 4127 is below 4581, so the search takes the leftmost downlink to a leaf.
The leaf holds 4127 and a pointer to its row in the players table, and Tapir's profile loads.
That took three page reads, one per level. One more level would multiply the keys within reach by the fanout, 3 here.
